text.*:
Buying battlestaves from Zaff
Profit per instance
28,440 per instance, after tax
Activity time
30 seconds
Minimum recurrence time
1440 minutes
Effective profit
3,412,800 per hour, after tax
Skill requirementsQuest requirements
None None
Item requirementsOther requirements
840,000 Elite Varrock Diary (lower is still helpful)
Experience gainedLocation
NoneZaff's Superior Staves
Inputs (840,000)Outputs (868,440, after tax)
840,000 × Coins (840,000)120 × Battlestaff (868,440)

Zaff will sell battlestaves under-price to players every 24 hours, resetting each day at 00:00 UTC. The number depends on how many of the Varrock tasks the player has completed: 15 staves with the easy tasks completed, 30 with the medium, 60 with the hard, and 120 with the elite tasks completed.

The profit above is based on the elite tasks having been completed. The profit for lower diary tiers is as follows:

  • Easy — 15 battlestaves for 105,000 coins, for a profit of 3,555 coins
  • Medium — 30 battlestaves for 210,000 coins, for a profit of 7,110 coins
  • Hard — 60 battlestaves for 420,000 coins, for a profit of 14,220 coins

Teleport to Varrock through the Varrock Teleport, enter Zaff's store north-west of the Square, buy the noted staves, and either bank them or sell them immediately.

Check the live price and daily volume of items on the Grand Exchange before making large investments in any method.
For newly added content, infrequently traded items, or sudden changes in price, the in-game market value may be inaccurate. All prices on this page are cached, meaning they may also be out of date.
To force a new cache of this page, click this link.
If a money making method is out of date, you can edit it or leave a message on the talk page.
